person_note: The controlling narration is third person across the three focal perspectives. Goodreads supplies multiple sustained third-person scenes for María/Sabine, Alice, Charlotte, and Lottie, while authorized opening and interior excerpts independently show the same pattern. The two isolated first-person quotations are local direct speech or thought rather than autonomous narrative sections, and the recurring verse is explicitly identified as in-story material. The only residual uncertainty is the missing local attribution around those decontextualized first-person quotations; the whole-book POV description and broad third-person excerpt coverage make an alternating-person structure implausible.
